instruction: Make all the text in the document italic.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent selected all text (Ctrl+A) and used Format > Text > Capitalize Every Word to convert first letter of each word to uppercase. Completed in 9 turns.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can select all text, navigate Format menu, apply text case transformations in LibreOffice Writer
metadata.task_rationale: Original task applied text case formatting to all text; this variation tests applying italic formatting to all text using the same select-all-and-format pattern
metadata.explanation: Task requires making all document text italic. Getter counts italic vs non-italic runs, metric checks that 95%+ of text runs are italic.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts italic status by iterating all paragraph runs and computing italic/total ratio
Metric correctly checks ratio threshold (>=0.95 for full score, >=0.70 for partial) matching the task requirement
Postconfig properly saves the document (Ctrl+S) before getter reads the file, ensuring changes are persisted
Single instruction requirement (make all text italic) is fully covered by the evaluator
Expected parameter handling is correct: empty rules dict is passed but metric is self-contained and only uses getter result
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: python-docx run.italic can be None when italic is inherited from paragraph style rather than explicitly set. Consider also checking run.font.italic or resolving inherited styles. In practice this is unlikely to cause issues since applying italic via UI sets it explicitly on runs.
